cards.stem: Which phrase correctly describes an interest rate in the vocabulary list
options: A percentage of a sum borrowed
A fixed monthly deposit for college savings
The total balance after graduation
Earnings from a part-time job
cards.quote: Interest rate: A percentage of a sum borrowed that is charged by a lender or merchant for letting you use its money.
cards.hint: Focus on the cost of borrowing money

cards.stem: How is compound interest explained in the key vocabulary
options: earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn
pay interest only on the original amount saved
withdraw earnings without any penalty
save money in a non-interest account
cards.quote: Compound interest: When you earn interest on both the money you save and the interest you earn.
cards.hint: Think about earning on earlier earnings

cards.stem: What does post-secondary education include according to the definition
options: all forms of schooling after high school
only four-year university degree programs
only job training during high school
only free online video courses
cards.quote: Post-secondary education: Includes all forms of schooling after high school, not just college.
cards.hint: Consider all options after high school

cards.stem: Which description matches the definition of an investment
options: you expect will earn a financial return
you spend without expecting any return
you borrow to pay tuition immediately
you save in a federally insured checking account
cards.quote: Investment: Something you spend your money on that you expect will earn a financial return.
cards.hint: Look for expectation of a return
